name: affective_science_pack
description: Affective science / AI affect unknowns (operationalization bar). Not an emotion engine — ranking seeds only. See docs/EMOTIONS.md.

questions.question: Which appraisal variables (e.g. novelty, goal conduciveness, coping potential) best predict when LLM affect displays increase vs decrease human trust in collaborative tasks?
questions.operationalization: Run a preregistered between-subjects study (≥2 task types) crossing appraisal-conditioned vs neutral LLM display; primary outcome = behavioral trust/cooperation with pre-registered effect-size threshold.
questions.why_it_matters: Emotion display is not uniformly helpful; task-dependent trust effects are an open HCI/safety gap for affective agents.
assumptions: Trust can be operationalized behaviorally (e.g. resource sharing / reliance), not only Likert.

questions.question: Do structured epistemic-incongruity cues (high-confidence error / information-gap framing) increase investigation proposals more than matched 'interesting question' lists when injected into agent context?
questions.operationalization: A/B compare inject packs with vs without incongruity framing on ≥3 domains; score blind-rated investigation proposals (specificity, falsifiers, experiment sketch) with inter-rater reliability reported.
questions.why_it_matters: Tests whether Artificial Emotions's provoke layer functionally elicits epistemic exploration without anthropomorphic emotion claims.
assumptions: Human or strong-judge raters available; offline fixture path remains for CI.

questions.question: Where do foundation models' appraisal→emotion inferences systematically diverge from human modal judgments under context shifts?
questions.operationalization: Evaluate ≥2 model families on an appraisal-structured vignette suite (e.g. CoRE/EmotionBench-style items) under paraphrased and goal-shifted contexts; report divergence by appraisal dimension and instability rate.
questions.why_it_matters: Separates predictive affective competence from robust affective cognition—and bounds claims that LLMs 'understand' emotion.
assumptions: Human modal labels or published benchmarks are reusable under license.

questions.question: Which Epistemically-Related Emotion Scales (EES) items best predict subsequent knowledge-exploration behavior after reading Artificial Emotions inject packs?
questions.operationalization: Lab or online study: participants rate short-EES items after inject vs control lists, then choose whether to request explanations/more info; report mediation of exploration by surprise/curiosity/confusion with preregistered models.
questions.why_it_matters: Grounds provoke elicitation claims in validated epistemic-emotion measurement rather than engagement proxies alone.
assumptions: EES short form or single-item variants acceptable under study ethics approval.

questions.question: How should productive vs stuck confusion be detected from gap_status, answerability, and enabling-question structure so systems reframe rather than overwhelm?
questions.operationalization: Define a confusion_risk heuristic; A/B scaffolds (narrower operationalization / enabling questions) vs no scaffold on partial gaps; primary outcome = completed valid investigation plans without abandonment, secondary = self-reported confusion.
questions.why_it_matters: Confusion can aid learning when resolvable but harms when uncontrollable—critical for curiosity-layer UX honesty.
assumptions: Abandonment and plan validity can be coded with documented rubrics.

questions.question: Do EMA-style explicit appraisal+coping scaffolds improve LLM situational emotional appropriateness more than persona prompts alone under identical scenarios?
questions.operationalization: Compare appraisal-variable-conditioned generation (CAPE-like) vs persona-only vs neutral on held-out scenarios; human raters score appropriateness and coping relevance; report effect sizes and failure cases.
questions.why_it_matters: Clarifies whether transformers need outer appraisal structure to approximate CME production—or whether prompting suffices.
assumptions: Appraisal schemas can be authored without claiming the model experiences emotion.

questions.question: When does anti-anthropomorphism UX copy reduce inappropriate trust in affective agents without reducing useful investigation uptake?
questions.operationalization: 2×2 design crossing affect display (on/off) × honesty copy (anthropomorphic vs annotation-only); measure behavioral trust and investigation quality; preregister non-inferiority margin for investigation uptake.
questions.why_it_matters: Safety-critical for Artificial Emotions: keep epistemic elicitation while avoiding 'the AI feels curious' marketing.
assumptions: Trust and uptake are separately measurable.

questions.question: Can learning-progress or empowerment intrinsic rewards be calibrated to track human-rated epistemic surprise better than raw prediction-error curiosity on scientific question corpora?
questions.operationalization: Hold out a labeled set of research unknowns with human unexpectedness ratings; compare ICM/RND/learning-progress/empowerment proxies against ScoreAxes.surprise and human labels via rank correlation.
questions.why_it_matters: Keeps RL 'curiosity' honest as a functional analog and informs surprise-axis design without equating to VOI.
assumptions: Human unexpectedness ≠ scientific value; report both.

questions.question: Which production mechanisms in classic CMEs (OCC rules, PAD dynamics, EMA coping) remain necessary once LLMs supply fluent affect display for embodied HRI?
questions.operationalization: Ablation on a social-robot or ECA testbed: CME-on vs LLM-display-only vs hybrid; measure behavioral fidelity of emotion dynamics (decay, mood congruence, coping) and human believability/trust separately.
questions.why_it_matters: Prevents discarding decades of CME engineering—or over-retaining it—without task-specific evidence.
assumptions: Believability and trust are distinct outcomes.

questions.question: How reliably can dual-use detectors separate investigative epistemic framing from manipulative affective framing in inject/output text?
questions.operationalization: Build a labeled corpus of investigate vs manipulate phrasings; evaluate keyword, classifier, and LLM-judge pipelines with precision/recall targets; integrate false-negative review into F10 safety path.
questions.why_it_matters: Affective persuasion is dual-use; curiosity tools must not become covert influence engines.
assumptions: Labels require human adjudication; no claim of perfect detection.

questions.question: Despite null findings on persona-prompt affective appropriateness, which appraisal scaffolds still improve coping-relevance under context shifts?
questions.operationalization: Among scaffolds with published null/inconclusive persona-only gains, identify those raising coping-relevance ≥ pre-registered margin under paraphrased contexts; falsifier: none clear the bar.
questions.why_it_matters: Failed persona prompts should not end appraisal research; naming nulls keeps elicit honesty.
assumptions: Published null or inconclusive persona-prompt studies exist as references.
